mapper.select: select syosio.*, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = syosio.create_user) as createUserName from sal_yt_order_sub_item_operation as syosio where order_sub_item_id=#{orderSubItemId} order by create_time desc

select syosio.*, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = syosio.create_user) as createUserName from sal_yt_order_sub_item_operation as syosio where (purchase_item_id=#{purchaseItemId} or (order_sub_item_id=#{orderSubItemId} and purchase_item_id is null)) and is_deleted=0 order by create_time desc
